_comment: Apex infra · Skew dashboard build-spec. HyperDX v2 stores dashboards in MongoDB with an internal shape, so this is a REPRODUCIBLE SPEC (source + query + viz per tile), not a raw import blob. Recreate in HyperDX: Dashboards -> New, add one tile per entry below against the 'Spark Events' source. Every tile's query matches sql/005 for the same job_id/window, so a tile and the raw SQL agree. See HYPERDX_SETUP.md.
name: Apex — Spark Skew

tiles.title: Skewed stages (p99/p50 > 5)
tiles.description: The core skew signal — mirrors sql/005 query (A).
tiles.sql: SELECT job_id, stage_id, argMax(task_duration_p50_ms, ts) AS p50_ms, argMax(task_duration_p99_ms, ts) AS p99_ms, round(argMax(task_duration_p99_ms, ts)/nullIf(argMax(task_duration_p50_ms, ts),0),2) AS skew_ratio, sum(spill_disk_bytes) AS spill_disk_bytes FROM apex.spark_events WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR GROUP BY job_id, stage_id HAVING skew_ratio > 5 ORDER BY skew_ratio DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.title: Max skew ratio over time (per job)
tiles.description: Time series; group by job_id. Uses the rollup for auto-acceleration (register spark_jobs_1m, 1-min granularity).
tiles.sql_equivalent: SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) AS t, job_id, max(task_duration_p99_ms/nullIf(task_duration_p50_ms,0)) AS max_skew FROM apex.spark_events GROUP BY t, job_id

tiles.title: Disk spill by job (bytes)
tiles.description: Skew's downstream symptom. sum__spill_disk_bytes accelerates off spark_jobs_1m.

tiles.title: Rollup skew (p99/p50 from stored sketch)
tiles.description: Mirrors sql/005 query (B) — recomputes percentiles from the quantile STATE in spark_jobs_1m.
tiles.sql: SELECT bucket, job_id, quantilesMerge(0.5, 0.99)(quantiles__task_duration_p99_ms) AS q, round(q[2] / nullIf(q[1], 0), 2) AS p99_over_p50 FROM apex.spark_jobs_1m WHERE bucket >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY bucket, job_id HAVING p99_over_p50 > 4 ORDER BY p99_over_p50 DESC
